abstract: We give a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm that allocates $m$ indivisible goods among $n$ agents with nonnegative additive valuations using $O(n^5\log^2 m)$ value queries and guarantees envy-freeness up to one good (EF1). Concurrent work of Lin, Liu, Tao, and Zhou achieves $O(n^8\log m)$ comparison queries, attaining the optimal $O(\log m)$ dependence on $m$ for fixed $n$. Each comparison query can be simulated using two value queries, so their bound also holds for value queries. Our contributions are a much simpler algorithm and proofs, and polynomial-time computation.
